name: Most frequent trips
query:
// Most frequent trips
MATCH (trip:Trip)-[:FROM]->(fromS:Station)
MATCH (trip)-[:TO]->(toS:Station)
RETURN fromS.station_name AS fromStation, toS.station_name AS toStation, count(trip) AS nbTrips
ORDER BY nbTrips DESC LIMIT 10

name: Create direct relationships bw Stations

Unweighted Pagerank
Weighted Pagerank
Max pagerank Station
query:
MATCH (s:Station)
WITH max (s.pagerank) AS maxPagerank
MATCH (s:Station) WHERE s.pagerank = maxPagerank

WHERE NOT (s)<-[:LINKS]-(:Station)

name: Parameters for pagerank algo
Appends s.rank for each iteration into s.ranks
query:
// Appends s.rank for each iteration into s.ranks
UNWIND range(1, $iterations) AS iter
CALL {
  WITH iter
  MATCH (s:Station)
  WITH collect(s) AS S,
       count(s) AS N,
       sum(CASE WHEN COUNT { (s)-[:LINKS]->() } = 0 THEN s.rank ELSE 0.0 END) AS danglingMass
  UNWIND S AS b
  OPTIONAL MATCH (a:Station)-[:LINKS]->(b)
  WITH b, N, danglingMass,
       sum(a.rank / toFloat(COUNT { (a)-[:LINKS]->() })) AS incoming
  WITH b, N, danglingMass, coalesce(incoming, 0.0) AS incoming, toFloat($d) AS d
  WITH b,
       ((1.0 - d) / toFloat(N)) + d * (incoming + (danglingMass / toFloat(N))) AS nextRank
  SET b.ranks = coalesce(b.ranks, []) + b.rank,   // snapshot avant maj
      b.rank  = nextRank
  RETURN count(*) AS updated
}
RETURN max(iter) AS iterations_done;
